errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, showing one stacked bar per year, each consisting of three colored segments. The description incorrectly states that the data is represented by three bars.

errors.text_span: für die Abwehr hybrider Gefahren etwa 3 Milliarden Euro ausgegeben werden

errors.evidence: The value for 'Innere Sicherheit' (purple segment) in 2015 is approximately 5 billion Euro (from ~31 to ~36 billion), not 6 billion. In 2025, its value is approximately 7 billion Euro (from ~44 to ~51 billion), not 11 billion.
